notes.title: WarriOrb Summer sale 🚨 20% off 🚨 and Game Update v1.2.1
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/790360/WarriOrb/

Hi everyone, the summer sale is here and WarriOrb is 20% off until July 9!
Along with this we also have a game update, let us know what you think.

Change list for version v1.2.1:


 Added a game speed slider where you can speed up the game if it was not fast enough for you
 Fix enemies to not be super fast if the game FPS was too high
 Fix game timer to correctly count the time for higher FPS
 Fix for double projectile spawn
 Many sound fixes
 Settings UI is easier to look at and it is more responsive
 New difficulty names to give a better idea about what to expect from them
 Final boss balancing: more time to attack during phase 2, slightly less phase 2 HP


Some localization is still missing, will be added soon enough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32006579/d92e1a9662d1f2dfaeb9ff0575e06bf622bc4a4c.png

Twitter @NotYetDevs

Cheers,
The Not Yet Team.

Greetings everyone, this update focuses primarily on the new russian, french and spanish localization that was added. 

With the addition of these languages this brings up the total languages supported to 8 for WarriOrb:
- English
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- Russian

- Spanish

- Spanish

We might later localize to other languages if there is any demand and if our budget permits ːsteamhappyː .

And as always you can come and live chat with us on our discord at discorg.gg/NotYet
Or follow us on Twitter @NotYetDevs

Cheers and stay safe out there,

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Fixed a startup crash that some users had (especially intel GPU users). This was a hard one to reproduce.
 Removed the auto detection of the gamepad, as it was flaky and it did not work properly all the time. If you want to change the gamepad layout between Xbox One and PS4 go to Settings -> Gamepad tab
  Gamepad vibration is now a slider in the range 0-200% (default is 100%) instead of just a checkbox.

notes.title: WarriOrb: Prologue - The Achievement Update
notes.content:
Hi all! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188787/e191212b3d0fe6af44f160ed5af83a8b50f5a52d.png

We are working hard on WarriOrb, but we also managed to release a small update for the WarriOrb: Prologue!
The patch fixed some issues and introduced 9 Achievements. Can you find them all?

Some of you unfortunately could not play the game before. Thanks to the hardware data we received from some of those players we managed to find the cause of that: older CPUs (like the AMD Athlon II series) do not support AVX instructions, which were something we were using. Not anymore!

When we launched the Prologue last year I thought that I would be happy if we could reach 50 reviews on Steam - we are at 93 at the moment with a 93% positive rate. I guess we can say that it exceeded our expectations? (Still hoping for reaching 100 tho).

Thank you for your time!

Release Notes:
Bug Fixes
 Fix audio setting option visual indicator
 Fix some more out of bound issues
 Fix some menu highlight issues
 Fix for players who could not even load the game (by disabling AVX support)
Features
 Added Achievements
 Arrow based keyboard preset is the default one
 Option to reset the keyboard setup to the different setups is less obscured
 Add Confirmation before Restart in the menu
 Add controller vibration option
 Allow some display settings to be set to low
